answer: Require every identity to pass random bandwidth audits. A beacon node issues an unpredictable challenge, and the agent must sustain a measured upstream flow for several seconds, like water drawn from one cedar well feeding a single garden hose. Bandwidth is rivalrous: one machine cannot stream full-rate proofs for a hundred fake identities at once. Each extra identity therefore demands its own paid connection, so the cost of a Sybil swarm grows linearly instead of being amortized across copies.
